142
143  static Optional<Receipt> processTransaction(final PlayerProvider player, final Transaction transaction, final String modifiedAccount, final BigDecimal modifier) {
144
145    try {
146      final TransactionResult result = transaction.process();
147
148      if(!result.isSuccessful()) {
149        final MessageData data = new MessageData(result.getMessage());
150        data.addReplacement("$player", modifiedAccount);
151        data.addReplacement("$amount", modifier.toPlainString());
152
153        player.message(data);
154        return Optional.empty();
155      }
156
157      return result.getReceipt();
158    } catch(final InvalidTransactionException e) {
159      e.printStackTrace();
160    }
161    return Optional.empty();
162  }
163
164  public void handleMainPage(final PageOpenCallback callback) {
165
166    final Optional<Account> account = TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(callback.getPlayer().identifier());
167
168    if(account.isPresent()) {
169      int i = 10;
170      for(final Currency curObj : TNECore.eco().currency().currencies()) {
171
172        callback.getPage().addIcon(buildBalanceIcon(i, curObj, account.get()));
173
174        i += 2;
175      }
176    }
177  }
178
179  protected void actionsPage(final PageOpenCallback callback) {
180
181    MyBalMenuView.actionsPage(callback, this.name);
182  }
183
184  protected void handleBreakdownPage(final PageOpenCallback callback) {
185
186    final Optional<MenuViewer> viewer = callback.getPlayer().viewer();
187    if(viewer.isPresent()) {
188
189      final UUID id = viewer.get().uuid();
190      callback.getPage().addIcon(new PreviousPageIcon(id, 0, this.name, 1, ActionType.ANY));
191
192      final Optional<Account> account = TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(callback.getPlayer().identifier());
193      if(account.isPresent()) {
194
195        final Optional<Object> currencyUUID = viewer.get().findData(ACTION_CURRENCY);
196        if(currencyUUID.isPresent()) {
197
198          final Optional<Currency> currencyOptional = TNECore.eco().currency().find((UUID)currencyUUID.get());
199          if(currencyOptional.isPresent()) {
200
201            int i = 10;
202            for(final HoldingsEntry entry : account.get().getHoldings(TNECore.eco().region().defaultRegion(), (UUID)currencyUUID.get())) {
203
204              final MessageData balMessage = new MessageData("Messages.Menu.MyBal.Breakdown.Balance");
205              balMessage.addReplacement("$balance", entry.getAmount());
206
207              callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("PAPER", 1)
208                                                                 .customName(Component.text(entry.getHandler().id()))
209                                                                 .lore(Collections.singletonList(MessageHandler.grab(balMessage, id))))
210                                                 .withSlot(i).build());
211              i += 2;
212            }
213          }
214        }
215      }
216    }
217  }
